title: Croatian Chestnut Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring the flavors of Croatia and the earthiness of chestnuts.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the sausage over medium heat, browning it on all sides.
Add the onion, carrot, and potato to the pot, cooking for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced chestnuts, soup, salt, and pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in the water, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the chestnuts are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
